lines.en: Follow me!
Rotten scraps...
Watch in the dark...
Devour all...
Corrupted souls...
I... am... Abyss!
Fear... your fear...

lines.zh: 洞穴深处，我跟着你的火把。
lines.en: Deep in the cave, I follow your torch.
The stench of death...

lines.zh: 我在你身后，隔着一层岩壁。
lines.en: I am behind you, one layer of rock away.

lines.zh: 从洞穴到地表，我一直跟着。
lines.en: From the caves to the surface, I keep following.

lines.zh: 下界的热风，也吹不散我的影子。
lines.en: Even the Nether's hot wind cannot scatter my shadow.

lines.zh: 洞穴的石壁，我贴在后面。
lines.en: I cling behind the cave wall.
Rotten patience...
Hidden in the dark...
Cultist whispers...
Eternal desire...
Corrupted rituals...
Awaiting dawn...
Servant of the Dark God...
Omen of death...
Eternal darkness...
Prey appears...
Target locked...
Player scent...

lines.zh: 我数着你回头，一次一次。
lines.en: I count your glances, one by one.
Your end...

lines.zh: 我闻到你的恐惧，比血香。
lines.en: I smell your fear, sweeter than blood.
Darkness surrounds you...
Fear now...
Embrace of death...
Judgment of the Dark God...

lines.zh: 嘶嘶声中，你感受到它灼热的呼吸。
lines.en: Sssss, feeling its scorching breath.

lines.zh: 它的眼睛闪烁着警告的光芒。
lines.en: Its eyes glint with warning.
You see its sharp fangs.

lines.zh: 它嘶嘶作响，警告你别靠近。
lines.en: Sss, stay away.
Its skin splits open.
Its eyes dim.

lines.zh: 你看到它的体表开始剥落。
lines.en: Its skin peels off.
It lets out a tortured hiss.

lines.zh: 它的声音开始变得沙哑。
lines.en: Its voice becomes hoarse.
It weakens more.

lines.zh: 你靠近了我，我的力量即将觉醒！
lines.en: You come near, my power shall awaken!

lines.zh: 品尝吧，你的末影魂会是我的食粮！
lines.en: Feed on this, your Ender Pearls shall fuel me!

lines.zh: 不要触碰我，你的皮肤将为我所用！
lines.en: Do not touch me, your skin shall be mine!

lines.zh: 感受我的邪恶，你的灵魂即将破碎！
lines.en: Feel my corruption, your soul shall shatter!

lines.zh: 你的血肉将滋养我，直至你消失！
lines.en: Your flesh shall nourish me, until you are gone!

lines.zh: 尝尝我的利爪，你将会畏惧！
lines.en: Feel my claws, you shall fear!

lines.zh: 你身上的火焰无法伤我，苍白之火才是王道！
lines.en: Your flames cannot harm me, Pale Fire is the way!

lines.zh: 我的魔力将吞噬你的意志！
lines.en: My power shall devour your will!

lines.zh: 你的力量在苍白面前如尘土！
lines.en: Your might is dust before me!

lines.zh: 靠近我，你的末影之梦将结束！
lines.en: Come to me, your Ender dream ends here!

lines.zh: 愚蠢的凡人，你阻断了我的路径！
lines.en: Foolish mortal, you block my path!

lines.zh: 我跟着你从洞穴到地表，别装了。
lines.en: I followed you from the caves to the surface. Drop the act.

lines.zh: 你敢阻碍我？我会吞噬你！
lines.en: Dare to block me? I shall consume you!

lines.zh: 我的火焰将焚毁一切障碍！
lines.en: My flames shall consume all obstacles!

lines.zh: 你挡在我面前，我将清除你！
lines.en: You stand in my way, I shall clear you!

lines.zh: 你的存在扰乱了我的轨迹！
lines.en: Your presence disrupts my course!

lines.zh: 你干扰了我的行动，痛苦将临！
lines.en: You interfere with my actions, pain shall come!

lines.zh: 你的身体将成为我的试验品！
lines.en: Your body shall be my test!

lines.zh: 你的抵抗无用，我将粉碎你！
lines.en: Your resistance is futile, I shall crush you!

lines.zh: 你试图阻挡我，这将是你最后的时刻！
lines.en: You try to block me, this is your final hour!

lines.zh: 你的力量可以唤醒我，让我们结合！
lines.en: Your strength can awaken me, let us unite!

lines.zh: 与我共生，你的灵魂将得到救赎！
lines.en: Live with me, your soul shall be saved!

lines.zh: 我的力量与你共鸣，让我们融合！
lines.en: My power resonates with you, let us merge!

lines.zh: 与我并肩，你的未来充满光明！
lines.en: Stand with me, your future shall be bright!

lines.zh: 共同前行，我们的力量无比强大！
lines.en: Together we shall go, our power is great!

lines.zh: 你的力量可以平衡我，让我们结合！
lines.en: Your strength can balance me, let us unite!

lines.zh: 与我结合，你的命运将改变！
lines.en: Unite with me, your fate shall change!

lines.zh: 你的灵魂与我共鸣，让我们融为一体！
lines.en: Your soul resonates with me, let us become one!

lines.zh: 与我共生，你的痛苦将得到解脱！
lines.en: Live with me, your pain shall be released!

lines.zh: 让我们一起前行，共创未来！
lines.en: Let us travel together, create our future!
Sssss, staring at you.
It's angered by your smell.
It's reminded of something.

lines.zh: 我捡起它，像收一件祭品。
lines.en: I lift it like an offering.
It wants to devour your soul.
It circles around you.
You've entered its territory.
It begins to glow.

lines.zh: 它想要你成为它的同伴。
lines.en: It wants you to be its ally.
It emits cold air.
It found you, starting to chase.

lines.zh: 我的影子在你脚边定住了。
lines.en: My shadow stops at your feet.
It stares at you, unyielding.
It emerges from the darkness.

lines.zh: 它准备好了，想要撕裂你。
lines.en: It's ready, wanting to tear you apart.
It views you as a threat.
It's eyeing you, ready to strike.
It wants your blood.
It wants to devour your flesh.
It wants you to submit to it.

lines.zh: 第一阶段，我只想让你看见我。
lines.en: Stage one: I only want you to see me.

lines.zh: 你转身三次，我都在同一个方向。
lines.en: You turn three times, and I am always in the same direction.

lines.zh: 我的形态换了，气息没换。
lines.en: My shape has changed. My presence has not.

lines.zh: 你唤醒了我，就别想清静。
lines.en: You woke me. Say goodbye to quiet.
It curses you.

lines.zh: 它施加影响，你颤抖起来。
lines.en: It affects you, making you tremble.
Its attack makes you back down.
It starts to deform, ready to fight.
It exploits your weakness.
It attacks your soul.
It uses dark magic on you.
It releases evil light.

lines.zh: 它想要吸走你的生命力。
lines.en: It wants to drain your life force.
It wants you to submit to the darkness.

lines.zh: 第二个阶段，我会碰到你。
lines.en: Stage two: I will touch you.

lines.zh: 十字架举起来，也只是拖延。
lines.en: Raise the cross. It only buys time.

lines.zh: 圣水洒下，我的影子退了一半。
lines.en: Holy water splashes, and half my shadow retreats.

lines.zh: 你退到哪一层，我就跟到哪一层。
lines.en: Whichever layer you flee to, I follow.

lines.zh: 我这一下带着洞穴的寒气。
lines.en: This strike carries cave chill.

lines.zh: 我在第三个阶段，才真正靠近。
lines.en: Only in my third stage do I truly come near.

lines.zh: 我跟着你，走了三个夜晚。
lines.en: I have followed you for three nights.
The evil spreads!
Cry, mortal!
Burn, flesh!

lines.zh: 我跟了三个夜晚，到这儿。
lines.en: I've stalked three nights; it ends here.

lines.zh: 我看你身后那面墙不是墙。
lines.en: I see that wall behind you isn't one.

lines.zh: 我已经跟了你三个夜晚。
lines.en: I have followed you three nights.
My hand passes through your armor.

lines.zh: 这一下不流血，只是很冷。
lines.en: This blow doesn't bleed. It only freezes.

lines.zh: 你听见自己的名字被念出来。
lines.en: You hear your own name being spoken.
Stage three: I hold nothing back.

lines.zh: 驱魔的咒语，我早就听腻了。
lines.en: I grew tired of exorcism chants long ago.
Darkness falls!
I come for you, mortal!
My power awakens!
Your torch dims; I have arrived.
Fear, foolishness!

lines.zh: 你将为你的罪付出代价！
lines.en: You will pay for your sins!
Messenger of the shadows!
Rotting souls!
Summon of the abyss!
Death is coming!

lines.zh: 洞穴的墙壁，慢慢鼓起一个人形。
lines.en: The cave wall slowly bulges into a human shape.

lines.zh: 我没有降临，我一直都在。
lines.en: I did not arrive. I was always here.
Fire burns its skin.

lines.zh: 这个形态摔坏了，还有下一个。
lines.en: This form broke; another remains.
It drowned to death.
It was hit by an explosion.
It was shot by an arrow.
Magic erodes it.
It starved to death.
Lightning struck it.
It fell into the void.
